chunks: And whatever is in it from Al-Kāhilī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr al-Bazanṭī, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Yaḥyā al-Kāhilī.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the compiler’s immediate source in this chain
key_terms.الْبَزَنْطِيِّ: Al-Bazanṭī, a well-known transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.الْكَاهِلِيِّ: Al-Kāhilī, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; indicates direct transmission by the compiler

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-Kāhilī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from al-Kāhilī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission through which the author received these hadith.
